name: go
label: Go
description: Go toolchain switching from go.mod (GOTOOLCHAIN=auto downloads the version go.mod asks for).

tools.name: go
installed: { go env GOVERSION 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^go//'; ls "$(go env GOMODCACHE 2>/dev/null)/golang.org/" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^toolchain@v0\.0\.1-go\([0-9][0-9.]*[0-9]\)\..*/\1/p'; } | sort -ruV | uniq

requires.name: go
check: if command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; echo "go not found (install it: https://go.dev/doc/install)" >&2; exit 1
